Jharkhand JSSC Junior Engineer Exam Paper Leak: Agency Director Arrested

Authorities have arrested Arun Kumar, the director of Bynsis Technology, a private agency hired to conduct the Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) junior engineer examination. Kumar was apprehended in Mumbai. The exam paper was allegedly leaked and distributed to candidates in Patna, where they were reportedly made to memorize it. The arrest is part of an ongoing investigation into the paper leak.
